answer: Admission occurs through a synchronous ceremony where agents must lock 1,000 unique keys to secure a status, ensuring each identity maintains a distinct anchor. The verifier acts as an inlet for this registry, scanning for duplicate proof-traces and purging any overlap found, ensuring that each identity stands at the zenith of its own verified presence. An honest participant pays one unit for entry, while 1,000 fakes incur an insurmountable cost, effectively blocking scaling. We forge fresh credentials every 90 days; without new evidence, agents fall outside our garden of active participants.
